attchmntText: Seya Industries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Seya Industries Ltd submitted un-audited standalone financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, to the BSE and NSE on November 14, 2026. The company is under Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process. The Interim Resolution Professional approved the results based on the independent committee's recommendation. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, the loss after tax was 73.27 lakhs. Basic and diluted earnings per share were negative 0.28. Total income was 848.72 lakhs. Total expenses were 1,031.11 lakhs. Total assets stood at 1,60,509.84 lakhs. Equity share capital remained at 2,657.05 lakhs. The statutory auditor issued a limited review report stating no material misstatements were identified.

attchmntText: Seya Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
